record.source_closeout_reference: End-of-day pickup aid authored at sponsor request; committed with the mission changes per the same_commit convention

mission.objective: Write the ladder pickup aid (key steps, scoreboard, remaining gates) so work resumes cleanly tomorrow, and update the V3-ANCHOR-004 registry row with the day's local evidence per the same-cycle closeout rule.

envelope.reference: Sponsor instruction in the Claude Code session: write key steps and remaining gates to a file for tomorrow, commit and push
envelope.not_created_reason: Bounded docs-only change executed from a direct thread-local sponsor instruction; this shadow record was authored during the mission.

forbidden_scope: no new approvals, gates, or promotion language
no evidence duplication that replaces source records
no validator, fixture, template, or skill changes
allowed_commands: scoped git add, commit, and push (sponsor-approved)
fallback_triggers: scope expands beyond the pickup aid and registry row
the pickup aid becomes a second source of truth instead of pointer-first

verification.summary: Advisory suite run at closeout; results recorded in the commit that carries this record.

notes: Docs-only pointer-first pickup aid; evidence stays in source records.
Registry row updated in the same change cycle as the anchor status change, per the registry closeout rule.
Scope stayed inside the pickup aid, one registry row, and this record.

friction_notes: The scoreboard duplicates pack-item status one level above the decision pack; acceptable for pickup cost, but the decision pack remains the source of truth and the scoreboard must be updated or deleted when the pack changes.
false_positive_notes: No advisory findings were raised on this change.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed after the advisory pass.

phase2_design_signals: A per-lane pickup aid (status, scoreboard, gates-in-order, parked follow-ups, read-first) is a cheap session-boundary artifact that complements the registry's repo-wide orientation.
